title: News Reflection: Mabuti pa ang luha ni Camille Villar
summary: Mabuti pa raw ang luha ng senadora, tumulo. Eh ang mga gripo ng PrimeWater customers?

blocks.text: Mabuti pa raw ang luha ng senadora, tumulo. Eh ang mga gripo ng PrimeWater customers?

Senator-judge Camille Villar makes a rare speech before the Senate Impeachment Court, in defense of four other senators who were absent because of troubles they were facing, legal or otherwise. She sheds tears for them, which, netizens joked, was more than can be said of faucets serviced by her family’s recently sold former company, PrimeWater.
Paterno Esmaquel II has this week’s News Reflection, where we ponder the words of our leaders in search of kernels of truth and wisdom, if there are any. – Rappler.com
